paintings.name: Wheat Field with Cypresses

provenance.metadataCaptureNote: Exact object was checked by reference owner; raw object response is not archived in the two-original manifest.

framing.note: Inner painted rectangle; exclude black surround and irregular canvas edge. Lower focus balances wheat, hills and cypress; wide cover intentionally omits the tree tip.

paintings.alt: A pine tree and pale mountain above a green valley crossed by a viaduct.

provenance.metadataCaptureNote: Exact object was checked by reference owner; raw object response is not archived in the two-original manifest.

paintings.name: Fantastic Landscape (coastal ruins)
paintings.alt: Small boats and figures beside coastal ruins under a blue sky.

framing.note: Use lower rectangular painted area beneath the arch. Exclude black upper corners, panel rim and bottom edge; retain boats and coastal ruins.

paintings.name: Landscape
paintings.alt: A low distant horizon beneath a broad peach and grey sunset.

framing.note: Exclude black surround. Bottom focus retains the very low horizon; original sky paint loss is not retouched.

paintings.name: Italian Landscape
paintings.alt: Warm chalk cliffs and an ochre valley in an Italian landscape.

framing.note: Crop inside the painted paper, excluding grey photographic backing, cast shadow and paper edge. Preserve central chalk valley.

paintings.name: Fantastic Landscape (ruins and boats)
paintings.alt: Classical ruins on the left and small boats on blue water to the right.

framing.note: Use lower rectangular painted area beneath the arch. Exclude black corners and panel rim; retain left architecture and right boats.

paintings.name: Wooded Upland Landscape
paintings.alt: Rolling wooded hills with cattle, a cart and figures on a winding path.

framing.note: Exclude narrow outer edge; lower focus keeps hillside, cattle and cart rather than an all-sky strip.

paintings.name: Imaginary Landscape
paintings.alt: A pale distant valley framed by dark trees, rocks and small figures.

framing.note: Exclude photographed outer canvas edge. Preserve naturally dark woodland and central valley light without exposure changes.

paintings.name: Fantastic Landscape (arch and harbour)
paintings.alt: A broad masonry arch, tiny figures and sailboats beside a harbour.

framing.note: Use lower painted rectangle beneath arched top, inside outer border. Narrow covers crop some outer shore while keeping the arch and central boat.

paintings.name: Roman Landscape
paintings.alt: A castle and distant Roman hills balanced by a large tree and small figures.

framing.note: Exclude black surround and brown panel edge. Retain castle and tree balance; historic joined-panel seams remain visible.
